name: cult-ui-dock

frames.best_why: The hovered mountain icon is magnified and lifted above the bar while the rest sit back.

tagline: App icons in a dark dock swell as the cursor passes over them.
summary: A macOS-style dock of round image icons that grow toward the pointer with a spring, with a draggable divider splitting the row.
appearance: A slim dark translucent bar with softly rounded corners floats over black, holding six small circular photo icons and a thin vertical divider. The hovered icon swells to twice its neighbours' size and lifts above the bar.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across the bar enlarges the nearest icon with a spring while the others settle back; clicking an icon makes it bob and shows a small dot beneath it.
demo_content: Six round Unsplash photos: mountains, a pug, palms, a waterfall, a campus and a rose.
search_phrases: mac style app dock with zoom
icons that grow when the mouse passes
app launcher bar with round icons
dock that enlarges icons near cursor
desktop style shortcut bar for a website
photo icons in a floating tray
use_when: You want a playful app launcher or shortcut tray that magnifies the item under the pointer.
avoid_when: The bar sits fixed at three-quarters width and resting icons are small targets on touch.
customise: Compose DockCard and DockCardInner children with an image source and id; width, spring constants and the dock position are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Six small images and pointer-driven springs; idle when the pointer is away.

a11y.note: Icon buttons use empty alt text and no labels, so screen readers cannot tell the apps apart; magnification is pointer-only.

issues: Icons have empty alt text and the buttons have no labels, so their names are lost.
Magnification responds only to the mouse, not to keyboard focus.
Resting icons are small touch targets.
polish_why: Magnification feels right and the bar is tidy; unlabeled icons and tiny touch targets are gaps.
